On November 19, 2022, {{player|anni|flag=de}} started the map anwalk2. After a period of 2 months, the map reached beta status on January 11, 2023. Even though the map is inspired by [[anwalk]], it includes a whole range of new areas and improvements. For one, it's now much more compact than before and the lightning gun has been removed from pent space and now has its own area. Roofs are no longer accessible. Anwalk2 got its final release in Febuary 20th, 2024.
